name: mirror-pane
description: Before/after simulator screenshots on the same step as a UI edit, side by side in a pane, with a changed-pixel percentage and pinned baselines

delayMs.title: Reload delay (ms)
delayMs.description: How long to wait after an edit for hot reload before the after-shot, 0 to 5000

noteToModel.title: Tell Claude
noteToModel.description: Add a one-line note to the edit result saying how much the screen changed (never the image itself)

extraPatterns.title: Extra UI paths
extraPatterns.description: Comma-separated path fragments that also count as UI files, e.g. src/widgets/,.html

historySize.title: History
historySize.description: How many before/after pairs to keep, 1 to 30
